provenance: Synthetic HTML rendered to PNG in browser; four controlled stress probes, not real social screenshots. Whole text including punctuation, whitespace normalized. No tuning of OCR on observed errors.
normalization: NFC; collapse whitespace; trim; case and punctuation preserved; whole displayed text, no excluded header.
ocrRuntime: Self-hosted Tesseract.js 7.0.0; rus+kaz; no tuning on these recognition results.
capture: cua browser screenshots of four authored HTML fixtures; PNG uploaded through the actual site file chooser, recognized text exported via the site JSON action.

limitations: Only four controlled synthetic stress probes; not representative screenshot OCR quality.
Earlier two clean OCR probes are reported separately; no pooling of incompatible normalization.
Engine v1.5 was informed by the mixed-wrap text during development, so classification results are development functional checks, not blinded detection accuracy.
One changed glyph or negation can alter a decision even when average CER is small. Manual correction is required.
